name: DAMIC
summary: DAMIC uses scientific-grade silicon CCDs as dark-matter targets, exploiting low-noise imaging and small-charge measurements to search for light dark matter. Its successor DAMIC-M has a separate record.
detection_principle: Pixels collect ionization charge generated in silicon. Diffusion width provides depth information, while spatial topology and radiation correlations help separate backgrounds.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
